title: The Idea Trap Cycle
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: An interactive diagram contrasting the closed 'refine the plan' loop with the open 'real-world test' path. Buttons send the founder around the loop or down the path while counters compare hours invested with real customer answers.

prerequisites: Chapter 1: Entrepreneurship, Lean Thinking & the Idea Trap
learningObjectives: Differentiate productive early-stage activity (real-world testing) from unproductive activity (endless refinement)
Recognize when a founder is personally in the idea trap

controls.label: Refine the Plan
controls.purpose: Send Jordan around the trap loop: hours go up, customer answers do not

controls.label: Test with Customers
controls.purpose: Send Jordan down the forward path: hours and real customer answers both go up

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive node-and-arrow explorer with comparative counters
keyQuestions: Why does refining the plan never change the number of real customer answers?
Which of your last three activities belong on the loop, and which on the forward path?
commonMisconceptions: Planning and polishing feel like progress, so they must reduce risk
A 'no' from a customer is a failure rather than validated learning
assessmentOpportunities: Sort your own recent activities onto the loop or the forward path
Name one forward-path action to take before the next session
